en_title: Kane Parsons Says He Is Working on Three 'Dream Projects,' Leading to Speculation Over Valve Collaboration
cn_title: 《后室》导演新项目引Valve合作猜测
subtitle: 三个梦想，暂时保密
opus_summary: 《后室》导演Kane Parsons透露正推进三个梦想项目，引发与Valve合作的猜测。他曾有意拍摄《传送门》电影，但尚未确认这些项目是否涉及Valve旗下作品。

paragraphs.en: Backrooms director Kane Parsons says he is working on three different "dream projects," which has caused no end of speculation regarding a possible collaboration with Valve.
paragraphs.cn: 《后室》导演Kane Parsons表示，自己正在推进三个不同的「梦想项目」，引发了外界对他可能与Valve合作的种种猜测。

paragraphs.en: When speaking on The Kyle Buchanan Show, Parsons confirmed he has three "dream projects" currently in the works, all while wearing a Valve hoodie. The young director has made no secret of his love for Valve, particularly Portal and Half-Life.
paragraphs.cn: Parsons身穿Valve连帽衫做客《The Kyle Buchanan Show》时，确认自己目前正在推进三个「梦想项目」。这位年轻导演从不掩饰对Valve的喜爱，尤其是《传送门》和《半衰期》。

paragraphs.en: Earlier this year, Parsons made his big-screen debut with Backrooms, a film adaptation/expansion of his highly popular web horror series. Ever since then, he's been a hot commodity in Hollywood. The filmmaker expressed interest in making a Portal movie around the time of Backrooms' release, which excited fans.
paragraphs.cn: 今年早些时候，Parsons凭借《后室》首次登上大银幕。这部电影改编自他广受欢迎的网络恐怖系列，并拓展了原作内容。自那以后，他便成了好莱坞的抢手人物。在《后室》上映前后，他曾表达拍摄《传送门》电影的兴趣，让粉丝兴奋不已。

paragraphs.en: Tomorrow, Kane Parsons comes on The Kyle Buchanan Show to talk about life since the BACKROOMS movie and what he’s working on next. Tune in for the full conversation wherever you watch or listen to podcasts! https://t.co/qu2F31jw1h
paragraphs.cn: 明天，Kane Parsons将做客《The Kyle Buchanan Show》，聊聊《后室》电影上映后的生活，以及他接下来正在筹备的项目。欢迎在你平时收看或收听播客的平台关注完整对谈！https://t.co/qu2F31jw1h

paragraphs.en: Following the release of his debut film, Parsons visited Valve's office , which has led some to believe that he's been actively meeting with the developer to bring their IP to life. This wouldn't be the first try at adapting Valve's franchises, as J.J. Abrams was attempting to bring Half-Life and Portal to the big screen. Abrams said in 2021 that he was still developing Portal , and that a script was being actively worked on. However, no one has heard anything since then.
paragraphs.cn: 首部电影上映后，Parsons曾到访Valve办公室，因此有人认为，他一直在积极与这家开发商会面，商讨将其旗下IP搬上银幕。这并不是第一次有人尝试改编Valve的系列作品：J.J.艾布拉姆斯此前就曾试图将《半衰期》和《传送门》搬上大银幕。艾布拉姆斯在2021年表示，《传送门》电影仍在开发中，剧本也正在撰写。不过，此后就再没有消息传出。

paragraphs.en: It's possible Abrams could help produce a Portal film from Parsons, or that Parsons could band together a new creative team. Either way, given the filmmaker's experience and love for Valve's IPs, he'd be a great fit. Whether or not Portal or Half-Life are part of these three "dream projects" remains to be seen, but he did note that they belonged to "powerful forces." He joked that he would be hit with space lasers if he said too much about them, something that doesn't seem as likely if it were an original IP or a continuation of Backrooms.
paragraphs.cn: 艾布拉姆斯或许会为Parsons执导的《传送门》电影担任制片人，也可能由Parsons另组一支创作团队。无论哪种情况，考虑到他的经验，以及他对Valve旗下IP的喜爱，他都会是非常合适的人选。这三个「梦想项目」是否包括《传送门》或《半衰期》，目前仍有待揭晓，但他确实提到，这些项目属于「强大的势力」。他开玩笑说，要是透露太多，就会被太空激光击中。如果项目是原创IP或《后室》的后续作品，似乎就不太会有这种说法。
